title: Partner marketplace copy hypothesis lab notes
body:
Purpose and scope:
- Quick working lab for copy experiments, UX wiring, and acceptance checks for partner marketplace tiles and partner-managed listings. Not a final checklist — this is a running sketch to feed into the formal preflight once we validate hypotheses.

Context:
- Audience: technical buyers (platform engineering), procurement evaluators, and devs trying a self-serve trial.
- Product surface: hosted API + Dedicated offer tiles; trial badge + meter-by-conversation SKU; optional KMS integration feature flag.
- Constraint: tile copy must fit marketplace character limits (varies by vendor), and all claims must map to legal-approved capabilities.

High-level goals for experiments:
1) Reduce “time-to-first-success” (TTFS) by making onboarding microcopy explicit: what to expect in 5 minutes vs 30 minutes.
2) Improve click-to-trial conversion by clarifying limits and trial upgrade path.
3) Surface cost signals early (preview of estimated cost per 1k tokens) without scaring away developers.
4) Add telemetry hooks to evaluate which copy variants actually move the needle.

Hypotheses (ranked):
- H1: Explicit ETA language on the tile ("Get started in <5 min — SDK, examples") increases tile_click rate by at least 12%.
- H2: Showing an example prompt + output snippet reduces support ticket opens in first week.
- H3: “Cost preview” microcopy that gives a range ("~$0.02–$0.12 per 1k tokens") reduces surprise and increases upgrade rate during trial.
- H4: A small compliance badge ("SOC2, EU data residency option") improves mid-funnel engagement for enterprise buyers.

Tile copy variants (short form for A/B tests) — keep under 80 chars for marketplace hero where needed:
Variant A: "Low-latency LLM inference — hosted API, scale to prod"
Variant B: "Deploy models with predictable latency & cost — API + dedicated"
Variant C: "Start a free trial — sample app, SDKs, and 1k-token credit"

Tile subtitle options (longer field):
- "Generate text, chat, and embeddings with streaming, tool-calls, and built-in rate limits."
- "SLA-backed endpoints, dedicated GPU pools, and private VPC options for regulated apps."

Microcopy snippets (for hover/tooltips and tile badges):
- Trial badge: "Free trial — 1k tokens, 14 days"
- Billing preview: "Estimated: ~$0.02–$0.12 / 1k tokens (depends on model)"
- Compliance badge: "SOC2 Type II · EU data region available"
- Scale note: "Autoscale to 200 rps per model with Dedicated"
- Failure fallback: "Auto-fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained — transparent logs"

Onboarding microflow text (for step-by-step screens linked from tile):
1) "Sign up with SSO or email" (help link to org provisioning)
2) "Create API key — choose hosted or dedicated" (tooltip: choose dedicated if you need reserved throughput and isolation)
3) "Run quickstart — CLI or SDK in under 5 minutes" (include sample curl and node snippet)
4) "See usage & cost preview in Console" (link to console telemetry mock)

Acceptance checklist (preflight) — minimal viable acceptance for marketplace publish (working draft):
- Copy and claims mapped to product capabilities: yes/no (list which claims need legal sign-off)
- Character length check per vendor: hero <= 80, subtitle <= 250, 3 bullets each <= 140
- Required assets: logo (SVG), 2 screenshots (app+console), short video (optional)
- Billing SKU mapping confirmed: meter id, trial SKU id, entitlement checks
- Security & compliance stub: data residency options documented, KMS integration steps available
- Telemetry hooks included (see signal list below)
- Support contact and escalation path documented for marketplace customers

Telemetry signals to instrument (priority order):
- tile_impression (tile_id, variant)
- tile_click (tile_id, variant, user_type)
- trial_start (tile_id, trial_sku)
- quickstart_run (example_id, success_bool)
- billing_preview_view (user_id, preview_range)
- upgrade_from_trial (trial_sku, paid_sku)
- support_ticket_opened (marketplace_source=true)

A/B test plan (quick):
- Universe: new impressions only; 50/50 split by user cookie or vendor experiment id.
- Primary metric: trial_start rate within 7 days.
- Secondary metrics: quickstart_run success, tile_click -> trial_start conversion, upgrade_from_trial at 30 days.
- Minimum detectable effect: 10% relative uplift; run until 1,500 unique impressions per variant or 14 days.

Edge cases & vendor-specific notes (things we need to check per marketplace):
- Some sellers restrict dynamic pricing text — we must provide static ranges rather than ranges computed at runtime. Add legal fallback language "Estimated cost shown for reference."
- Marketplace tile length differs by region/localization — keep canonical copy modular to swap short/long fields.
- Billing flow may require separate SKU bundling for trials in APAC. Confirm with finance.

Legal & compliance questions for legal review (send to Legal: @Priya):
- Can we publish the phrase "SLA-backed" in public tiles, or does that require SLA doc link in listing?
- Does the trial credit wording need an expiration/timebox clause beyond vendor default?

Operational readiness notes (SRE/ops):
- Ensure console link in tile routes to partner-aware onboarding (pass vendor_ref param).
- Add a fast-fail fallback message that maps to support runbook: "If you see 503s, retry with cached model variant and open support ticket #MARKETPLACE-1."

Quick UX copy experiments to try next sprint (prioritized):
1) Swap hero CTA from "Start trial" to "Run quickstart" and measure drop-off in sign-up flow.
2) Add a one-line example of prompt+output under subtitle for the developer audience (use a short JS example).
3) Test compliance badge vs no badge for enterprise leads attribution.

Open TODOs and unknowns (notes to self):
- Get vendor-specific character limits for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces (ASK: Maya to fetch by 2025-10-06).
- Confirm finance SKU IDs and whether trial SKU consumes credits differently in partner-managed listings.
- Align with Product: final list of supported models for tile claims (e.g., latency guarantees per model).

References and links (draft):
- Confluence: Product marketplace guidelines (CONFLUENCE-12345)
- Jira: GT ticket for tile telemetry (JIRA-GT-678)
- PR: marketplace tile assets (github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-tiles/pr/42)

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally scrappy — please add inline comments rather than editing high-level hypotheses. We'll finalize copy after first micro-experiment and legal sign-off.

Change log (mini):
- 2025-09-15: initial draft (Avery)
- 2025-09-22: added telemetry signals and acceptance checklist (Maya input)
- 2025-10-03: added trial billing copy variants and open legal questions (Diego)
short_summary: Working lab of copy variants, microcopy, telemetry, and a lightweight preflight acceptance checklist for marketplace partner tiles. Draft status; experimental hypotheses prioritized.
recommended_next_steps: 1) Get vendor character limits from Maya; 2) Wire telemetry instrumentation with Eng (ticket JIRA-GT-678); 3) Run initial A/B for hero CTA vs quickstart
